# Clavis 3.2

## ✨ New

- **Open encrypted files without decrypting them to disk** (Clavis Pro). Double-click a `.enc` file and it opens in its usual app — no decrypted copy is left next to it. Edit it, then **save the changes back** into the same encrypted file, or just **re-lock** it. A note in the status bar shows what's open.
- **Double-click `.enc` files.** Encrypted files now show the Clavis icon and open in Clavis. With Clavis Free, double-clicking offers to decrypt the file.
- **Nothing is left behind.** Files you opened are wiped when you re-lock them, when you close Clavis, and when your PC locks or sleeps (edited files are kept so you never lose work). If your PC crashes while a file is open, Clavis offers to save your edits next time it starts.
- **Quick actions in the tray:** Encrypt files… and Open encrypted file…
- Right-click an encrypted file → **Clavis → Open** is now at the top of the menu.

## Install / upgrade

- **Already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now). The double-click support appears after Clavis next starts.
- **New install:** download **Clavis-Setup.exe** from the website and run it.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
